meta.title: 平板支撑细节｜如何避免腰酸，让腹发力
meta.title_en: Plank Details | How to Avoid Lower-Back Pain and Engage Your Core
meta.topic: 健身教学 · 核心训练

scenes.context: 正确平板支撑先看手掌：不是抱拳，而是掌心朝下与肩同宽；肩胛骨不是夹着，要向两侧撑开。语域：健身教学，纠错口令。
sentences: 手掌不是抱拳，而是掌心朝下，与肩同宽。
Don't make fists — place your palms flat, shoulder-width apart.
palms flat（掌心朝下）；shoulder-width apart（与肩同宽）
肩胛骨不是夹着，要向两侧撑开。
Don't pinch your shoulder blades together — spread them outward.
pinch together（夹着）；spread outward（向两侧撑开）
这是腰发力的平板支撑。
This is a plank that engages your lower back instead of your abs.
engage（发力）；lower back（腰部）
paraphrase: 掌心朝下 → palms flat / palms facing down
撑开肩胛 → spread the shoulder blades / open the shoulder blades
scenes.speak: Don't make fists — place your palms flat, shoulder-width apart. Don't pinch your shoulder blades together — spread them outward. This is a plank that engages your lower back instead of your abs.

scenes.context: 头部不要后仰，要保持颈部中立，让头、颈、背在一条直线上。语域：健身教学，细节纠错。
sentences: 头不要后仰。
Don't let your head tip back.
tip back（后仰）
要保持颈部中立。
Keep your neck neutral.
neutral neck（颈部中立）
头、颈、背在一条直线上。
Keep your head, neck, and back in one straight line.
in one straight line（一条直线）
paraphrase: 颈部中立 → neutral neck / spine in line
一条直线 → one straight line / aligned
scenes.speak: Don't let your head tip back. Keep your neck neutral. Keep your head, neck, and back in one straight line.

scenes.context: 腰不是向下塌，要腹部收紧、略微向上拱起，让腹肌真正参与发力，避免腰酸。语域：健身教学，发力讲解。
sentences: 腰不是向下塌，要腹收紧。
Don't let your lower back sag — tighten your abs.
sag（下塌）；tighten your abs（收紧腹部）
略微向上拱起。
Slightly round your back upward.
round upward（向上拱起）
这才是腹发力的平板支撑。
This is how you make the plank work your abs.
work your abs（练到腹）
paraphrase: 向上拱 → round upward / arch slightly
scenes.speak: Don't let your lower back sag — tighten your abs. Slightly round your back upward. This is how you make the plank work your abs.

scenes.context: 双脚不是并一起，而是打开与髋同宽，更稳定。掌握以上细节，做的平板支撑才能发力在腹上。语域：健身教学，收尾总结。
sentences: 双脚不是并一起，而是打开与髋同宽。
Don't keep your feet together — spread them hip-width apart.
hip-width apart（与髋同宽）
掌握以上细节。
Master all these details.
master the details（掌握细节）
做的平板支撑，才能发力在腹上。
Only then will your plank actually engage your core.
engage your core（核心发力）
paraphrase: 与髋同宽 → hip-width apart / as wide as your hips
核心发力 → engage your core / activate the abs
scenes.speak: Don't keep your feet together — spread them hip-width apart. Master all these details. Only then will your plank actually engage your core.

practice: Place your palms flat, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your neck neutral, head, neck, and back in one line.
Tighten your abs and slightly round your back upward.
Spread your feet hip-width apart for stability.
pitfalls: Don't make your hands into fist.
Don't make fists — place your palms flat.
「抱拳」用 make fists（握拳），不是 hands into fist。
Don't pinch your shoulder blades together — spread them outward.
夹肩胛是错误示范；正确是 spread outward（向两侧撑开）。
Don't let your lower back sag — tighten your abs.
腰下塌是错误；用 sag（下塌）表达纠正。
双脚并拢不稳，正确是 hip-width apart。
shifts: 用 pinch together（夹着）、sag（下塌）、tip back（后仰）具体指出错点
说核心用力只会 use strength
用 engage your core（核心发力）、tighten your abs（收紧腹部）、work your abs（练到腹）
用 neutral（中立）、aligned（一条直线）、shoulder-width（与肩同宽）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：抱拳→握拳、与肩同宽、肩胛骨、颈部中立、向下塌、向上攻→向上拱、与宽同宽→与髋同宽、臂一起→并一起等。
